description: This file defines multiple Sass mixins for creating various gradient backgrounds, such as linear, radial, directional, and striped gradients, for use within the project's styling.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: Applies a gradient background to an element if gradients are enabled; otherwise, sets a solid background color.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient from a start to an end color with specified stops.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient from a start to an end color with specified stops.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified angle between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient with three colors, with a middle color stop.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient with three colors, with a middle color stop.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient transitioning from an inner to an outer color.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped gradient pattern at a specified angle.
